Method of Attack: Delivered via malicious XLS attachments that run a macro function executing msiexec.exe to download and run a digitally signed MSI archive, which extracts and runs an executable that decrypts and runs another executable in memory, ultimately downloading and decrypting a malware payload (wsus.exe) that launches the final malicious payload directly into memory
Attack Vector: Spam email with malicious XLS attachments
Indicators of Compromise: Hashes of digitally signed executables used in the campaign
Digitally signed executable extracted from MSI archive
Malware payload named wsus.exe digitally signed on June 19
